column1: Verify monitor.py invokes research collector during market hours and records are idempotent.
- [ ] monitor.py runs every 5 minutes during market hours (cron: */5 9-15 * * 1-5)
- [ ] Run same collection cycle twice → NO duplicate records
- [ ] Verify count in market_snapshots_5m matches number of unique 5m candles
- [ ] No duplicate timestamps for same symbol
- [ ] Each snapshot has valid timestamp (5m candle end)
- [ ] Each snapshot has price (closing price of completed candle)
- [ ] Evidence records reference correct snapshot timestamps
